name: healtrip-patient-decision-assistant
description: HealTrip AI Patient Decision Assistant — NestJS agent backend + Next.js chat UI.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
